column1: # Characters the traditional dictionary writes in Taiwan's form (2026-10-20,
# the user: "统一繁体固定使用台湾用字字形，处理掉混用"). Applied by
# scripts/normalize_traditional_forms.py to every word of two characters or
# more in the generated traditional files; single characters stay, so that a
# variant can still be typed on purpose. Kept as they are, since Taiwan writes
# them too: 泄 (排泄 beside 洩漏), 台 (舞台), 煙, 濕, 醣 (多醣), 塚, 餬 (餬口),
# 鎚, 纍 (纍纍), 陞 (陞遷), 踰 (踰越), 綑 (綑綁), 罎, 榦, 麯, 糍, 苧, 么, and the
